author: kycrafft
body:
My ideas:

First idea

So basically the game will be played out like normal, except you can score throughout the whole game. Along with the current scoring, teams will also be rewarded every 3 seconds. You can score 1 point for every person alive on the hill once the 3 seconds has ended. This gives players the incentive to control the hill the entire game in order to win more points 

(Happens every few games in the rot)

Second idea


This idea involves the hill providing supplies. Every 30-40 seconds items are dropped all over the hill for the duration of 5 seconds. The game will announce it in chat, hopefully getting players to rush towards the center. Think of it like a feast in the Hunger Games. 

Possible items that could spawn:
-12 arrows
-Golden apple
-Spalsh potion of healing II
-Fish
-Blindness orb
-Lightning orb  
-Splash potion of harming I
-Gold sword, 15 durability, fire aspect 1

3rd idea:

Every team will be assigned 1 person after points are scored. This person will be able to score 20 points (and reward the team each 2xp) if they make it into the center. This person will have resistance 2 and slowness 1, though. 

So what do you think? These ideas can be used separately or together. Give me some suggestions, too!
